# 2.0.1

- Remove unused Jest, npm, duplicate type-support, self-link and optional WebSocket accelerator dependencies; keep only packages exercised by source, build, tests or demos.
- Update Axios to 1.18.1 security fixes, migrate the entire toolchain to TypeScript 7, replace `ts-node` execution with `tsx`, and adapt the RPC guard to the TypeScript 7 scanner API.
- Run deterministic `npm ci` checks on the maintained Node.js 24 LTS line instead of the end-of-life Node.js 20 line.
- Generate checked-in `lib/**/*.d.ts` files through explicit `types:generate` / `types:watch` scripts and mark them as generated, read-only artifacts in the agent rules.
